name: New Jersey NJSIAA Meet of Champions Cross Country
headline: Meet of Champions: Starkey runs 16:38, Union Catholic makes it five
summary: Ocean Township’s Leah Starkey, the No. 2 girl in the country, won by more than a minute in 16:38.21, faster than her 16:45 on the same course a week earlier. No. 1 Union Catholic won a fifth straight Meet of Champions girls title, led by Cayleigh Kaiser (second, 17:42.46) and Paige Sheppard (third). In the boys race, CBA’s Gavin Schmitt won in 15:17.61, 17.5 seconds ahead of West Windsor-Plainsboro North’s Agrim Jha.
